name: My Pet Egg Farm
desc:
🐣 Welcome to Grow A Farm!
Build your own egg-producing empire! Hatch adorable pets, upgrade your farm, and collect rare and powerful eggs. Sell your harvest, unlock new areas, and become the ultimate Egg Farmer! Become a mega rich and wealthy tycoon!

⭐ Grow your pets
🥚 Hatch rare eggs
💰 Earn and upgrade
🌾 Expand your farm

Can YOU build the biggest egg farm in the world?
